C0410.title: Uber 2022 MFA Fatigue Attack Incident
C0410.summary: In September 2022, Uber disclosed an internal-systems security incident. Public reporting indicates that the attacker used credentials for an external contractor account and repeatedly triggered MFA requests until the contractor approved a login, giving the attacker access to Uber internal systems. Uber linked the incident to Lapsus$ and said it found no evidence that user accounts or sensitive user data were accessed.
